data.current_summary: Market-wide 13F holder flows for a closed quarter: what each kind of filer bought and sold of 13F common shares, its net flow, net flow as a percentage of its prior 13F book, and net buyers against net sellers. Trades are each filer's share changes priced at the security's average close over the quarter, else its quarter-end value per share (an exit at the quarter before's); options and principal amounts are left out, and a share change from a corporate action reads as a trade. Only filers with a 13F the quarter before are compared. Holder type, client base and private funds are each filer's current regulatory profile, never its name; style, turnover, horizon and book size are measured from its own 13F book that quarter. With groupBy=sector each bucket's flow is split by its issuers' sectors, with exchange-traded products apart. Quarters still in their 13F filing window are not computed.
data.summary_suggestion: Analyze market-wide 13F holder flows
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves market-wide 13F holder flows for a completed quarter, showing aggregate buying and selling activity by filer type. Metrics include net flow, net flow as percentage of prior quarter book value, and net buyer/seller counts. Share changes are valued at the security's average quarterly close price or quarter-end price. Only filers with 13F filings in both the current and prior quarter are included. Results can be grouped by sector using the groupBy parameter. Excludes options, principal amounts, and corporate action-driven share changes. Filer characteristics (holder type, client base, regulatory status) reflect current regulatory profile. Note: Quarters still in their 13F filing window are not included.
